sections.label: Show
sections.description: Narrow the datasets to one kind of data: photon streams, decays, correlations, histograms, traces, burst runs, structures or images. A group stays while one of its members is of that kind.

context_menu.label: Open in…
context_menu.description: Give the selected data to a tool that takes it; no tool takes this data when the item is dimmed.

context_menu.label: Save
context_menu.description: Save the selected dataset to a pickle file.

context_menu.label: Load
context_menu.description: Load a dataset saved with Save into the session.

context_menu.label: Remove
context_menu.description: Remove the selected datasets (a member of a group removes its group). A burst run under its photons is removed from the project's analysis container, together with every analysis computed from it (fusions, analyses of those); you are asked first, with those analyses named.

context_menu.label: Embed in project
context_menu.description: Store the selected linked files inside the project file at the next save (checked against their recorded checksum first), so the project no longer needs them.

context_menu.label: Link to file
context_menu.description: Write the selected embedded files back to where they were linked from and link them again; the project gets smaller at the next save.

context_menu.label: Sign in to MMFDB…
context_menu.description: Open the MMFDB sign-in for the server a linked object is on (its rows show a key); then choose Fetch again. Your password and session never go into the project.

context_menu.label: Fetch again
context_menu.description: Fetch the selected linked MMFDB objects (or all not fetched yet) into the local cache again, after a sign-in or when the server was unreachable.

context_menu.label: Group
context_menu.description: Join the selected datasets into one group; a fit of the group has one curve per member.

context_menu.label: Ungroup
context_menu.description: Split the selected groups back into their datasets.

context_menu.label: Refresh
context_menu.description: Read the dataset and fit lists from the session again.

sections.description: The loaded datasets. Select one (ctrl or shift-click for several) to add a fit to each; drag one onto a fit window to fit that dataset instead; Delete removes it (a burst run also from the analysis container, with the analyses computed from it, after a warning); right-click for Save, Load, Remove, Embed in project, Link to file, Group, Ungroup and Refresh; a 📦 before the source means the data is stored inside the project; a group unfolds with its triangle. A narrow panel drops Experiment, then Source; right-click the header to choose the columns.

columns.description: Position of the dataset in the session; a member of a group is numbered under it (3.1, 3.2).

columns.label: Data name
columns.description: The dataset's name (its file name by default).

columns.label: Kind
columns.description: What the data is: photons, a decay, a correlation, a histogram, a trace, bursts, a structure or an image.

columns.label: Experiment
columns.description: The experiment the dataset was read for.

columns.label: Source
columns.description: The file or container the data came from; hover a row for its full address.

sections.description: The fits. Select one to show its window and its parameters in the Analysis panel.

columns.description: Position of the fit in the session.

sections.label: Model
sections.description: This selection box is updated according to the selected dataset.

buttons.label: Add from MMFDB…
buttons.description: Pick a photon stream or an image stored in an MMFDB database and link it (mmfdb://artifact/<id>): the project records its address, size and checksum, the object is fetched into a local cache with your MMFDB session, and nothing is downloaded into a loose file.

buttons.label: + Analysis
buttons.description: Add a fit of the selected model to the selected dataset; its window opens.

buttons.label: Remove dataset
buttons.description: Remove the selected dataset from the session.
